reviews.comment: Pre-meds be warned. He didn't round up a 89.8 to an A. There are very few people in life who I genuinely dislike, Dr. Dae is that. He will probably laugh when he reads this but I mean it with my heart, he genuinely hurt my chances of getting into med school and my future because of .2 points. I hate profs like that.

He is a very funny professor, but he lets this get in the way of his lectures. He would take huge chunks out of class to play games, tell stories, and tell jokes. Because of this, he would get behind and skip certain parts of units. His tests had super specific questions that were not written on the slides, just briefly mentioned in class.

Dr. Chung was very funny and entertaining. However, his tests were very specific and often contained material that wasn't on the slides or was only mentioned briefly. He does give out a lot of extra credit, which is very helpful and balances out his tests. He had a lot of in-class games, which were always fun. If you take him, study the slides!

Dr. Dae is a really great prof and makes his classes enjoyable. His exams are often filled with really intricate details that were on the slide and can make the class seem really intimidating but he is really helpful in his office hours, and if you take the time to study and memorize you can do well. He also gives a bunch of extra credit.

Extra credit is based on attendance, so for that aspect showing up is important. Lectures are pretty funny and he is honestly a very caring person. I thought his jokes were pretty funny and he is engaged with his students. His tests were not extremely difficult and as long as you payed attention in lecture and reviewed the slides you were okay.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I have mixed feelings about him and this class. He barely taught and we mostly played games. When he did teach, it was like he was presenting a group project he didn't care about. Tests were HARD. STUDY!  He chooses to be very specific even though he doesn't teach like that. He offered lots of extra credit at the end. Never rounds/curves.

Hilarious professor. Cares about your success for sure. Little to no busywork. Gives out ample extra credit, however if he had made exams easier and not pulled ultra specific questions from the textbook that wasn't on his powerpoints, it probably wouldn't even be needed. Class is difficult so study hard and in advance!
Amazing proff. A lot of extra credit so go to class. He dies fun games for even more extra credit. Exams were very fair. Best bio proff you could have.

He gives a lot of extra credit so go to his lectures. Exams are not difficult if you just look at his slides and attend class. He's very genuine and cares a lot. If you take anything away from all these reviews it's that he is the best 112 bio professor

This class pushed me out of my comfort zone in a good way by getting me to network. This is a great class for learning how to network, create resumes, and be interviewed. The only downside is that you can't miss class, or it will deduct a lot from your grade. The workload is fairly light, but there are a few projects that are more time-intensive.
I really enjoyed this class! There is a lot of work, but it is relatively easy assignments. Please go to class!! Attendance is very important in this class.

Great professor and class! The professor is really easy to work with and communicates really well with the class. The guest lecturers were all really good and interesting. There's an attendance check in for every class so make sure to go to lectures.
Great professor. Always willing to work with you and very chill. Lecturers are super interesting. You just need to make sure to show up for class or its a heavy loss of points.
Chill guy. If you got perfect attendance he said he would write you a rec letter.
Dr. Chung is very generous with his time and his professional contacts. All the guests were very willing to elaborate more on their career.
Dr. Chung makes it easy to visualize where a biology degree can actually take you.

Dr. Chung is a chill guy and idk how he brought in so many professional guest speakers. Sometimes there would be multiple guest speakers for one unit. I liked that you got different perspectives of professionals in that career.
Chill guy. Just wish the criteria/rubric for the major assignments were a little more clearer for the class.
I appreciate how Dr. Chung highlights non-traditional paths in bio, not just med school. It helped me realize that I want to do environmental conservation work.
Dr. Chung is basically a career counselor with a PhD in Biology.
If you want to actually use your bio degree, take Dr. Chung. He shows you the way by having guest speakers come.
Dr. Chung is very organized and ensure every guest speaker aligns with the curriculum. He made it a very cohesive class.
The Dr. Chung acts as a great moderator between us and the high-level researchers he brings in.
This professor is basically a career coach disguised as a biology lecturer. Best elective I've taken in my senior year.
I've never had a professor so dedicated to networking, he even made a spreadsheet for us to connect to people within the class.
Super approachable. After the guest speakers leave, the professor spends time helping us talk to those professionals in their specific fields.
Great mentor. They clearly have a massive network and use it to help us find our own niche in biology
Love how this prof prioritizes our futures. The guest speakers are cool, but the professor's ability to connect the lectures to real-world career paths is what makes the class good.
He is chill, but don't turn in work late because he makes it clear he doesn't accept late work.
He manages the guest speaker's time efficiently, so there is always time to ask questions at the end.
You always know who is coming and why they are relevant to your future.
He'll let the Q&A run long if he sees that we're really getting value out of it.
He makes sure the speakers tell us their failures so we don't feel bad about ours.
He literally hands out a contact sheet for every speaker who is willing to take interns
He hosts "lunches" with the speakers after class. Who else does that?!
He weaves the guest's expertise perfectly into the week's lesson plan. It's seamless.
He lets the guest speakers take center stage because he genuinely wants us to learn from the best.
He doesn't just show us what a researcher does; he makes the speaker explain how they got the job.
He picks speakers who struggled but despite that, they still made it.
He's the definition of an educator. He teaches you how to think, how to work, and how to succeed.
He's an industry insider. He knows what recruiters want and brings in speakers to prove it.
He's very insightful. He always summarizes the guest talks with "the 3 things you need to remember for your career."
He's very supportive. He encourages us to ask any question so we actually learn how the industry works.
He makes sure the guest speakers are people who actually hire entry-level grads.
He's very transparent. He asks speakers to be honest about the struggles of the bio field, not just the perks.
He's the only one making a real effort to show us what life after college looks like.
He brings in people working in cutting-edge biotech, not just stuff from 20 years ago.
He's always looking for ways to connect a student's interest to a speaker's expertise.
Even when he brings in big-name researchers, he makes the environment feel casual and safe.
A true advocate. He pushes the guest speakers to talk about the "dirty details" like salary and work-life balance.
He constantly reminds us that the speakers were once sitting in our exact seats. Very encouraging since the future seemed undetermined
He's a great bridge-builder. He translates the dense biology material into real-world applications through his guests.
He's changing the game. Most profs are stuck in their research bubble, but he's plugged into the actual industry.
Incredibly thoughtful curator. He made sure to bring in speakers from non-traditional paths, not just the standard "med school" route.
He goes the extra mile. He doesn't just bring in speakers; he prepares us with "speaker bios" so we can ask smart questions.
The most practical teacher I've had. He balances tough academic concepts with "here's how this makes you money" guest talks.
I was feeling lost, but his focus on career paths gave me a second wind.
He uses his own professional network to give us a leg up in the job market.
He leads by example and shows us how to network effectively.
He balances the medical speakers with research ones so everyone feels included.
He's already planning next semester's speakers based on our feedback, so I have high hopes for this course.
He made sure to bring in speakers from underrepresented backgrounds in biology.
He encourages us to stay after class to talk one-on-one with the guest lecturers.
He's very relevant. He makes sure the speakers discuss current trends in medical and research tech.
He's all about networking. He basically hands you a professional network on a silver platter.
Super insightful. He knows exactly which questions to ask the speakers to get the best info for us.
He genuinely wants every student to find their niche in biology.
He's a career coach in disguise. Take his class if you want to feel prepared for the real world.
He's very modern. He knows the current bio job market and brings in people who are currently in the thick of it.
He's so intentional. Every speaker was chosen to highlight a different way to use a biology degree.
He's very approachable. After the speakers leave, he spends time helping us process the career advice.
Good professor, kinda hands off since he lets his TAs grade most of the assignments.
He's a mentor first. He uses the guest speakers to provide us with the "unwritten rules" of the bio industry.
He's a connector. He literally facilitates the networking for you. You just have to show up.
By bringing in pros, he proves that his curriculum is actually used in the real world. Very career-oriented.
Helped make us make outside connections and even gave us the opportunity to have lunch with these guest speakers. Very thoughtful
Super thoughtful. He always leads a Q&A after speakers that helps us dig into the "how-to" of their career paths.
Incredible professor. He makes a point to introduce us to researchers and doctors so we can start networking early.
Goes above and beyond. Most profs just read slides, but he curates a speaker list that is actually relevant to our futures.
Kind and amicable professor. The work is unexpectedly a lot for a 1-hour credit course. Make sure you keep up with due dates, as there are no extensions regardless of a Student Rule 7 excuse.

Funny guy and makes class entertaining but not the best prof. Reads off a script he has written on his computer and doesn't actually teach. Exams are insanely specific. I got a 99 in 111 and am barely holding on to this class. labs are MUCH easier than 111, though. Lots of extra credit, but worth very, very little. I recommend taking someone else!

Professor Chung is great, but for a 1 hour course it is more work than youd expect.  Preparation and reflection due every week, which arent a problem at all, but the additional assignments can be a little much.  Also beware of TAs.  One is a very harsh grader while the other is very lenient, but likely will change in subsequent semesters.

Loved hearing speakers who gave practical advice on the next steps. Gave great tips for applications & how to be professional in the field. Dr. Chung was a great character, always being funny & creating opportunities to make connections. He is a great resources for understanding the field of biology. Assignments were ok but could be more in depth.
Dr Chung was great; make sure you go to class because every unexcused absence is -25 pts on your final grade but very fun and easy class and he is a really funny guy.
Professor Dae is an amazing professor and would take again.

He's a good teacher, teaches well and is super funny, his exams are probably the easiest set of exams I have ever taken. He's funny too. You don't even have to show up to class, I only showed up to try to pull but ofc I couldn't :(  . Probably an easier A than HS, if you can take him go for it. Studying for the exams takes max 2 hr. Lab is free too
Very kind and entertaining.

The class was very interesting and motivating since the professor brings in many people from different backgrounds of biology to talk about their journey to where they are now and provide tips for such a career in that field. There is a lot of work for a one credit class but as long as you show up to class, they are easy to complete.
it was a good course, and attendance was mandatory if you wanted to get the assignments completed
The professor was respectful, entertaining, and easy to learn from. I would absolutely take this class again; it definitely prepared me for the professional world

He is a great prof and wants us to learn about every bio field. All his assignments are directly related to lecture so show up and listen. Attendance is worth points so dont skip, but overall an easy class and fun prof.

Dr. Chung is genuinely the best! This class was an easy A, about 2 assignments per week but they are usually short and easy. Attendance is mandatory, but the guest speakers that are brought in are so informative and interesting to listen to. A few major assignments, but they are helpful for your future career. Highly recommend taking this class!

Dr. Chung is really chill, 302 is super easy, it's mostly just listening to guest lectures and writing reflections. Attendance is required. There are a couple assignments that are longer than they probably need to be but they are genuinely helpful so its not that big of a deal. Super easy A, just show up to class.
Very fair grading, with the only requirement being to show up for lectures. I wouldn't have liked the course material as much if it weren't taught by Dr. Chung.

If I were to look up the word iconic in the dictionary, Dr. Chung's photo would be under the definition. He is incredibly kind and fun, yet balances professionalism very well. The course has exposed me to different careers and has helped me understand what I need to do for my future. Attendance is mandatory, but you'll want to be there.

Great professor and super easy class. One of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Guest lectures every class with a preparation and reflection for each. Assignments on resumes and even has an AI assignment. Very easy to get an A. I got an A with absolutely no effort. Great way to grow your connections in a lot of industries.

Dr. Chung created a chill atmosphere for students to learn about careers. There are quite a few homework assignments, but nothing difficult just weekly reflections, preparation assignments, and career exploration activities. I suggest giving yourself enough time to complete them.
Wouldn't have taken this class with another prof.
Easy class and very fair grading.
Amazing prof and super nice! Attendance is mandatory, so don't skip. There are a lot of assignments and some take a bit of time, but it's really not too bad overall.

This course may be only one credit hour but it still comes with a surprising number of requirements, and at times, the workload can feel heavier than expected.Because of this, it is important to stay organized and keep track of deadlines so you do not fall behind. Despite the workload, the class itself is very beneficial and enjoyable in many ways.

Dr. Chung is a professor who is there for his students success. His class was very informational and applies to students future, helping them figure out what they would like to go into. You need to have him as an professor. I been here for 3 years and never had a STEM professor who cares about his students like him. Trust me take his course!

This class was amazing and extremely helpful. You must attend the lectures, but you are going to want to! They are so insightful, and you walk away learning so much. Dr. Chung is so understanding and offers amazing chances to network. Definitely take it as early as you can!
A lot of assignments for a 1 credit course. Should be more straightforward.

Dr. Chung had guest speakers come in and present, which I found very interesting and insightful. It is very important to read rubrics for assignments because there was not an overview of them from Dr. Chung, however, he said this may change in the future. There are a lot of big assignments and the grading criteria is made very clear in the syllabus
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Essentially, Dr. Chung invites guest speakers to speak about their career journey, so he's not teaching too much. The overall course is very manageable since it's mostly just writing either 100-300 words or 300-500 words (depending on each assignment). He's really chill and funny! Definitely take him for an easy, stress-free time in class.
Dr. Dae is a very caring professor, who is always available to students. This class is mainly guest speakers who give incredible advice about their professions and life in general.
He was extremely helpful and open to suggestions. The speakers were motivational and inspirational. Definitely take his class it was super easy!!

NEED to take this class!! It's super well organized and easy to follow, and it genuinely helped with job exploration and networking. I picked up a lot of useful skills along the way. Dr. Chung is also really communicative and always clear about expectations. Overall, such an amazing professor!!

Guest speakers come once a week to share their experience and knowledge. Few large assignments and weekly assignments. Overall, the class was informative about other opportunities. The professor also made the class enjoyable. Just do your assignments on time and show up to class.

Great, very easy class. Two short weekly assignments, 5 larger assignments throughout the semester. LOVED that guest speakers would come every week to talk about their careers. Very engaging, not boring! Would give up opportunities to network with speakers outside of class. Overall, great easy class!

Class is very mandatory, no exams, just complete assignments before due date for a good grade. Requires about 30 min-1 hour a week outside of class. Great professor, very forgiving. Only gripe is the TA's grade everything and have weird requirements that are not on the rubric.

I took BIOL 302 for the fun of it, but what I'm going to miss the most is Professor Dae Chung. He is so fun and easy to talk to. He has two TAs, so ask them about any questions you have about the homework before submitting it. Would take this class again 100%!

Good prof and very informative class. Each week, you get to hear guest speakers in various biology fields. Had good networking opportunities. However, GO TO EVERY CLASS HE WILL TAKE OFF SO MANY POINTS. Other than that, there are a couple of assignments that are kind of time-consuming for a one-hour course... the 8/10 class was pretty chill overall.

This class is hard no matter who's teaching, but he's for sure one of the better options. He cares about students, LOTS of extra credit, candy everyday, + he's rlly funny. Labs are easier than 111, and exams 2+3 have a TON of material, so study early. His exam questions are randomly specific sometimes, but 112 material is just hard in general

Chung is kind and funny, but I would take a different prof like Runshi if you can. His exams are unnecessarily detailed and hard because he wants to challenge you, and he goes a bit too in-depth when making questions. He does give a lot of extra credit, but honestly, an easier exam would be better. Lectures are okay, but I used YouTube to learn.

Dr. Chung was a great professor. He had very entertaining lectures. There were many fun games and activities. However, he tends to just read off the slides rather than add a lot of more in depth information. He offers so many opportunities for extra credit, which I highly recommend you participate in. Overall he was great and I would take again!
Gives out a lot of extra credit, keeps students as engaged as possible in lecture and you can tell he genuinely loves his job which makes learning a little better.
Keeps students engaged and gives a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Honestly he wasn't the best prof but it's not hard to do well in the class if you like the study on your own. The tests are very specific but they aren't as hard as other profs and if you write down what he says and memorize the slides your guaranteed like an 80 at least. The extra credit and the lab genuinely saves your grade

Honestly he was a super great prof, lots of extra credit opportunities. bio 112 is just a hard class in general so it's not his fault but you can do really well if you just show up to class and do well on the lab portion

GREAT PROFESSOR! He's really funny and incorporates jokes into his lessons, making it easier to remember certain topics. He does give extra credit with iclicker questions that are seen on exams and by random games. Exams are hard but with good studying and remembering the iclicker questions can really help.

yes, he is funny and yes go to class because there might be funny EC games, but his teaching style is definitely not for everyone. i wouldnt take him again since his exams are extremely hard compared to the course level. you could study the powerpoints but you need to take notes of what he SAYS in lecture  since it might be a question on the exam.
extra credit is luck based on a random game that he does at the end of class, tries to make funny jokes. reads off the slides and sometimes exam questions can be very specific.

TESTS ARE HARD. He is a funny guy, but I don't love his teaching style personally. I think hes a nice guy, but I had to read the textbook to teach myself. Iclicker attendance is ec but it is worth it.
Dr. Chung is an amazing lecturer and goes the extra mile to make the class easy to engage with.  Exams are straightforward, and there are plenty of extra credit opportunities in class.

Dr. Dae was the best bio prof I've ever taken. His exams were hard, and had some very specific questions that could only be found on the slides or when he spoke. However, he was funny and a fair grader. Don't miss class because you could miss a shoe-throwing contest for EC.
Tests were difficult but doable. He was funny though, I would take him again.

As a lecturer he's hilarious and seems to genuinely care about your success. Gives out extra credit as well for attending lecture. Your grade is split pretty evenly between exams and labs/assignments. The exams are pretty difficult and require LOTS of studying. Be sure to study the ppts AND textbook (some info isn't found on the ppt).
STUDY for tests lots extra credit!
VERY GOOD PROF!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Chung is one of my favorite professors I've taken at A&M. He's kind and very accessible outside of class. Exams are straightforward if you study. Be sure to utilize and take notes on what he emphasizes in class, and review the iclicker questions and homework assignments. They will for sure be helpful for the exam.
if you miss class you might miss a ramen eating competition or a visit from an influencer. He taught us that it is possible to be successful if you switch your major. Memorize plants and protists.
As a pre-med student, I appreciated the rigor. They don't sugarcoat the material, which I know will help me when I'm studying for the MCAT
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Encourages class participation without making it awkward. Felt comfortable asking questions
Really solid professor. Biology can be dense, but they break down complex metabolic pathways into steps that actually make sense. Available during office hours most of the time.
A very middle-of-the-road experience. Nothing flashy, just good, consistent teaching and clear expectations. Dae Chung is the best out of all the 112 professors
The exams are tough but fair. As long as you show up to lecture and do the reading, there are no 'gotcha' questions. Definitely a 'what you put in is what you get out' class."
A if you go to class, for sure B if you dont. Extra credit given in class

Great guy. He is funny and makes his lectures not eye bleedingly boring. However, his exams are over tedious small details on the PowerPoint and there is not much practice available. I am sure the exams are easier if you actually listen during his lectures. I did not. Listen.
Really funny professor and cares a lot about his students, His tests can be hard because he tests on random info from his powerpoints.
Tests very hard but he's very funny so it's a trade off, get ready to memorize random facts about random organisms

Attendance is not mandatory, but it's so worth going to class. There is lots of extra credit and good practice. He might bring an influencer or give out kimchi-making vests. He teaches great and is very respected. His exams are harder than the practice, but the same content.

He is a chill, cool guy, but some days he lectures for 5 minutes and waste time playing games based on chance. He is good about given extra credit, but his exams are always harder than the practice. Funny times, but sometimes not so funny (when i get by grades back). You never really know what will happen that day. He is unpredictable, but fun.

He is a very nice guy who wants to make his students laugh, yet this causes his lectures to become off topic often. His class has like almost no homework and your grade is basically determined by how you do on tests.
Very nice professor but he does go off topic quite a bit and tests are fairly difficult and requires lots of studying. Extra credit is given during class so attend lectures!
Tough exams, they have a lot of material. Be prepared to study a lot.
Good professor but he wastes a lot of time on jokes. Makes silly videos instead of exam review. Poor exam prep
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Extra credit in class so go to class
extra credit in class.
Great professor, can be very silly
Just read the textbook. Lectures are so unserious, its a waste of time.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Unserious at times, but a great professor. Would highly recommend.
Has a cool brother.
Super hard. RUN lol

Dr. Dae is funny and makes class engaging even when the lecture slides become boring. He often provides fun games within class and tells jokes throughout his lecture. He has i clicker quizzes in most lectures for extra credit, and you simply need to participate to get full points.
He is a great professor, but sometimes he plays too much. Would rather him lecture the whole time then make random jokes that take 10 minutes of lecture time.
Keeps you entertained. Take him. He can teach well. Extra credit given in class.
He keeps you very interested in the lectures. Lots of extra credit opportunities if you go to class.
Love him but exams are hard.
Dr. Dae is great! Offers lots of extra credit, and exams aren't too bad if you study the slides. Take him!

Personally, I wouldn't take him again because the lecture style wasn't helpful for me, but he's a good prof! He offers extra credit so show up to lectures, and there isn't too much homework. Slides are kinda long and small details show up on tests.

Super chill guy. Gives a ton of extra credit during iclicker and it doesnt even have to be correct to count, you just have to participate. Exams relatively easy if you study IMO. Plays games with the class when lecture gets too boring. Practice exams (practice exercises) resemble exams. Def take him!!!

Dr. Dae is funny and makes class engaging even when the lecture slides become boring. He often provides fun games within class and tells jokes throughout his lecture. He has i clicker quizzes in most lectures for extra credit, and you simply need to participate to get full points. Tests are semi-difficult and are based on the slides in class.

Lectures are just basically him reading directly off the slides, and there's nothing new in lecture that you can learn that you can't find on the slides. You won't actually learn anything and the slides aren't organized at all. Very difficult to study for.

He was amazing! You could tell that he truly cared about his students and wanted them to succeed. His test were tough but it is a college class so I didn't expect anything different. Overall I definitely would take his class agian.

Very funny guy, made a lot of jokes which kept the lecture lighthearted. He often ended class early because he felt like it without sacrificing time for content. Sometimes he was unclear on what would be on the exam but he tried his best to emphasize anything he thought would be important.
he was good just study iclickers, hella a-able

The exams weren't hard if you studied. The exams were heavily based on the lecture slides and a little bit of outside information from the lectures. You can not attend class and still get an A in this class. He makes fun exams, and I had fun taking them.
Dr. Dae is very kind and keeps lectures exciting, even though the material can be a bit boring. I would not have wanted to take another professor! He's great!
Great prof take him

He tries to make lectures fun and engaging. His exams are very lecture heavy, so as long as you attend class and study his slides, it shouldn't be that difficult to get a good grade. He gives extra credit through iclicker, and it's all participation, so you don't even need to get the answer right to get the points.

Overall a good professor. Lectures/slides are a little boring, he pretty much just reads off the slides. Tests are okay, just memorization and some application or extensive knowledge. Good amount of extra credit.

The professor is able to keep student engaged even when topics may seem tiring or too much, he always kept us bright, alert, and responsive. His test can be difficult when he chooses, but most of the material can be found within his PowerPoints. You can tell he enjoys his job and puts in quite a bit of effort. I recommend studying and attending SI.
Extra credit, good lectures, exams very similar to slides. STUDY HARD. Great professor.
Funny guy. Lots of extra credit.
Great lectures, very easy to follow. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he does I-clicker questions and fun games for extra credit! Exams are doable, just need to memorize the slides.
Great professor. Exams could be difficult to study. Extra credit in class, so go to class

the guy is really chill and plays games during most lectures which is fun, but when we go through actual content it's soo boring and hard to follow what he's saying. his exams require thorough understanding of the content so you really gotta know everything on his slides and beyond to do well. he also doesn't curve exams ever so just beware.

great lectures but they can be a waste of time as extra credit games (luck based) take up half the class some times. Tests can be difficult but all information can be found in the lecture slides. Overall, Dr Dae is a great guy.
class very easy, lost of extra credit, but RNG based, so you might not get any of them and he also likes to think ur cheating on test when ur not but class is funny and easy to get A
Most unserious class. Easy to get A, but won't learn squat.
He was caring and wants you to learn rather than get a good grade. Study for exams.
The class itself is hard, but he makes it easy to understand. Some practice exam questions are the same as the exam. Lots of extra credit.
Great professor however the exams are extremely hard. He does not give a study guide. Gives extra credit if you go to class.

Overall a really great person and professor. The lectures are different from a normal class in that every week you have a guest speaker from a different profession and they give you a talk about what they do. It's a great way to connect and meet people from the veterinary school and medical school but also like the CDC and some corporate spaces.

Professor Chung is a really nice and funny guy. He always tries to make the class more entertaining, despite how heavy the lecture is. You should definitely study for the exams, though, and he does give out plenty of extra credit.

Dr.Chung is a really good professor but his exams are very difficult and rely heavily on information he talks about in class. He gives extra credit through I-clicker but most of the time it is some sort of game that is based on luck and not material related to biology. He's a great lecturer and makes class really fun and is always willing to help.

Dr. Dae does a great job of making his class engaging and fair. The content is heavier and more challenging than 111 and the exams are difficult but he includes all of the information you need on his slides (often more than necessary). It can be hard to discern what is actually important. Regardless, if you put in the time you will be successful.
Take this prof, study for his exams.
This is the best bio 112 teacher

A really fun and caring professor, he has the class play a lot of games in class for extra credit. His lectures are okay, however his exams can be a bit difficult as they often test on edge cases and minute details that were mentioned once in the entire lecture. Otherwise, a fun person to talk to, very easily accessible both in person and online.

THE GOAT! He's so engaging and caring and so funny! Genuinely the best prof I've had and it's not close. Fair exams, heavier on memorization but it comes with the territory so just muscle up. TAKE HIM!!
This guy is awesome and super funny. Gives extra credit almost every class.

Dr. Dae is a great professor this class. The tests are reflective of the lecture slides (no textbook questions). Lots of extra credit and fun activities during class. Open to answer questions outside of class. Would take again!

He is funny most of the time but he likes to make jokes that are demeaning to the class. There are a lot of days where he waste a lot of time with non biology things. He does give out extra credit but it's based on games that are pure luck.
He's so funny and engaging. Coming to class helps both on the test and getting extra credit. He really cares and works hard to keep students interested in biology!

Chill guy, but also snarky. Lectures are pointless as he reads off slides or does some random game, so you can easily self-teach the class. Class has extra credit iClicker, so that's nice, and tests aren't worth that much. Tests are also relatively easy.
He is truly a great professor take him if you can!
Great professor! Lectures are easy to follow and exams are manageable as long as you understand the problem sets and practice tests. Lots of extra credit opportunities in class. Take Dr. Dae!

Professor Dae is a really nice guy, personally the amount of jokes side track me during lecture, but if you can manage jokes and lecture together, take him. You won't leave a class without laughing. Lab is lab to be honest, not much there.
He is fun and his lectures are easy to follow!

Love this man! He is hilarious and makes his lectures so fun. Content it hard but he makes it more enjoyable. Hard exams.

TAKE HIM! He's a great professor, not boring at all, and engages his students well. Tests are hard but doable. Not too much homework. I've never laughed harder in a class. He's awesome.

Dr. Dae is super funny and entertaining so he doesn't make coming to class dreadful otherwise it would be. Bio 112 is just tough. super funny prof even though the class's content is boring. gives in class extra credit so make sure you go to class. exams are hard but if you can remember whats on the slides you'll make an A.

He's amazing, I laughed every time i was in his class. And he made tedious lectures enjoyable. 10/10, highly recommend

This professor is amazing. The class is really doable with 1-2 assignments every week. The essays are also doable, just make sure you are revising your paper based on the TA/profs guidelines and recommendations if you want a good grade! Overall the professor is accessible and is always quick to respond to emails!

Dr. Chung is very straightforward and organized! Grade is mostly made up of 3 essays (divided by drafts, 2 peer reviews, and a final draft), and reflection discussions with required readings. Highly recommend reaching out to the prof and TA for additional feedback before submitting the final draft as it's important to address ALL their suggestions!

If you're going to take BIOL 403 online I would recommended Dr. Chung! The way his class is set up in Canvas is very organized, and he's accessible after class, even late at night on due dates! reviews.comment: Engaging and amusing lecturer! He's pretty straightforward in what he teaches and whats going to be on exams. Attendance is not mandatory but highly encouraged, as he offers in-class extra credit often. Lectures are very informative and can be a lot if you fall behind, but is understanding if you are putting in the work. 100% would take again!

Dr. Chung was an amazing professor! His class was really enjoyable to attend, and he offered so many opportunities for extra credit to help boost your grade. He also allows a one-page cheat sheet for the exams, but not the final. There was minimal homework; make sure to study well for the exams :). I would retake him!

Dr. Dae was an amazing professor. He is in my top 2 professors I have ever taken before. He offers "cheat sheets", front and back of copy paper, for every test besides the final. Teaches the material in an engaging way.

Very understanding professor. Flexible with deadlines if you communicate and always willing to help. The class never felt stressful. Not the most structured course, but the low pressure made it enjoyable.

Very energetic and engaging! Lectures go by quickly because they're interesting, but the pace can be a lot if you fall behind. Not an “easy A,” but super rewarding. Great for students who like fast, high-energy classes.

No tricks, no hidden expectations — what you see is what you get. Lectures are straightforward, and the study guides match the exams. Grades fast and gives good feedback. Not the most exciting lecturer, but extremely fair and reliable.

Probably the most caring professor I've ever had. Actually checks in on students and is understanding about life happening. Passionate about teaching and it shows. Class feels like a supportive environment. If you appreciate genuine kindness, take them!!

If you're new to this subject, take this professor. Breaks things down so simply and walks through examples step by step. Never assumes you already know anything. Exams directly reflect what's covered in class. Perfect intro-level instructor.

This professor makes every lecture entertaining. Uses real-life examples, funny stories, and makes even boring topics interesting. Participation matters, but it's fun. I actually looked forward to going to class (which is rare). Would 100% take again.

Not gonna lie, this class is HARD — but the professor is so good at teaching that you actually learn the material. Exams require real understanding, not memorization. If you want an easy A, maybe not the best choice, but if you want to actually understand the subject, take them.

Super chill class. Lectures are relaxed and not overwhelming, and the workload is manageable even with a busy schedule. As long as you go to class and do the assignments, you'll be fine. Honestly one of the least stressful professors I've had.

Amazing professor! Explains concepts clearly, gives great examples, and truly wants students to succeed. Super approachable during office hours and never makes you feel dumb for asking questions. Exams are fair if you keep up. Highly recommend!

Dr. Dae is really caring and tries to get everyone to pass his class! Be prepared to read, you have to read lecture slides to pass his course, he focuses on concepts in exams. He also gives a lot of extra credit opportunities during class and a few outside of class. Office hours do help if you need to enter understand the material!
Professor Chung was a really chill teacher. He made learning the material we studied fun and gave many extra credit opportunities.

Our grade was based on 3 exams, practice questions weekly, and a cumulative final. Dr. Dae was an incredibly caring and kind professor who tried his best to make us laugh every lecture by playing games and giving us tons of opportunities for extra credit. We were his first class, and it showed that he really enjoyed teaching. Take him.
Dr. Dae is such a nice professor he cares about his students a lot and give a lot of extra credits, study and you will do good in his class
Professor Dae is fun and loves to joke around during lectures. The class is lecture-heavy, but if you pay attention, the exams aren't hard. I would definitely take this class again!

Amazing professor, exams make up most of the grade

One of the most straightforward tests you will get from this prof

MC Exams, Full page cheat sheet front/back. turning in CS gives u +2 points. Exams based on Lect and some vids.Simple Q's

Great professor! He's really funny and tries to engage with the class to make learning more fun. If you show up to class everyday and lock in, this class will probably be the easiest A you'll get.

Amazing professor. Gives clear class expectations. Lecture material corresponds with exams, nothing is ever a surprise. Gives in class extra credit to help with grade. Pay attention and study and you will do good in class.

Very engaging lectures, attendance not mandatory but offers extra credit during some lectures. Exam questions are very similar and sometimes exact same as practice questions discussed in class. Textbook available but you don't really need it.

Dr Dae is the goat. He was so happy to teach us about this class and wanted to make it legitimately fun. He always taught us games from back home whenever the lecture started to get slow. He makes sure you have all the resources you need to get the grade you want. You definitely have to work for it, but this class won't ruin your semester. Take it.
Amazing professor! Gives out lots of extra credit and candy EVERY class. favorite science professor i've had so far!
